thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: High error rate detected in generation cluster us-east-1 for model redwood/gpt-open-7b. Error rate > 30% over 5m. Paging maya (oncall). Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/infra/generation

maya (oncall): On it — triaging now. Seeing 502s and some OOM traces in container logs. Collecting stack dumps and pod descriptions.

tom (sre): Pulling logs. `journalctl -u gpu-runtime` shows repeated `Killed process` entries from gpu-3 and gpu-7. Could be KV cache growth combined with long-sequence sessions. Recommend failover while we investigate.

maya (oncall): Initiating traffic reroute to fallback model variant and reducing max sequence length for in-flight requests. Running command:
```
/orchestrator route set --policy fallback --model redwood/small-q --pct 100 --region us-east-1
```
Estimate 10-15m to stabilize.

sam (support): Two paying customers (acct: builderco, acct: finlytics) reported increased errors. CS notified. Need an interim blurb for customers.

olivia (cs): I'll create a short bridge note and open a customer call if needed. Can someone confirm ETA and scope (percent of requests impacted)?

maya (oncall): Quick impact: ~4% of production requests, skewed to sessions with >1024 token sequences. Auto-retries may have caused duplicate token counting for some customers. Mitigation in progress.

incident-bot: Handoff: maya is passing on-call to tom for deeper mitigation and follow-through. Paging tom.

tom (sre): Taking over. `kubectl describe pod gpu-3` shows CrashLoopBackOff with OOMKilled. Two nodes showing similar patterns. I'm scaling worker pool + draining suspected nodes to isolate. Also running a memory-profiler on runtime.

leo (eng): Pushing a runtime patch to cap KV cache memory usage: PR hfm-pr-89. I'll deploy a canary to 10% of traffic in us-east-1. Patch reduces default KV soft-limit from 6GB -> 2GB.

renee (product): Noted. We need to track SLA exposure and prepare external comms. I'll own the post-incident customer messaging plan.

maya (oncall): Canary looks good — error rate returning to baseline. Marking mitigation as successful. Creating postmortem ticket and scheduling follow-ups.

sam (support): Sending initial customer-facing note now: "We're aware of increased errors in US East and currently mitigating. We'll follow up with an RCA and timeline." Sending to impacted accounts. (:+1:)

olivia (cs): Draft for customers (please review):
```
Status: Partial service degradation in US East (us-east-1)
Impact: Some generation requests returned errors; long-running chats (>1024 tokens) most affected.
Mitigation: Traffic routed to compatible fallback model; runtime memory cap patch deployed.
Next: Full RCA and timeline within 48 hours.
```

tom (sre): Adding postmortem action items here: 
- A1: Enforce KV cache soft limit and add config guardrails (owner: leo)
- A2: Add OOM + stacktrace alerting to the on-call dashboard (owner: tom)
- A3: Add retry de-duplication to prevent duplicate billing/charges (owner: maya)
- A4: Run long-sequence capacity test in staging (owner: eng-performance)
Please add estimated due dates.

maya (oncall): Proposed postmortem doc sprint: tomorrow 09:30 PT. Attendees: maya, tom, leo, olivia, renee, sam. I'll create the calendar invite and pre-populate the doc.

olivia (cs): Calendar ok for me. I'll draft the customer follow-up timeline: initial note now, RCA draft in 48h, final customer one-pager + validation logs in 72h.

renee (product): For trust rebuild messaging, propose 3 phases: 1) immediate incident summary + mitigation, 2) technical RCA + action plan, 3) validation report + compensatory steps (if SLA breach). Tone: transparent + technical. Agree?

maya (oncall): Created ticket INC-2026-3381 and linked logs + traces. Postmortem doc (draft): https://docs.redwood/infract/INC-2026-3381

tom (sre): Quick updates for remediation tracking:
- A1 (leo): in progress — PR opened hfm-pr-89, runbook updates pending
- A2 (tom): todo — will add alert and dashboard widgets this week
- A3 (maya): todo — adding de-dup logic to retry handler, ETA 1 week
- A4 (eng-performance): scheduled next Wed for load tests
I'll populate the remediation table with owners, due dates, and verification steps.

sam (support): Customer comms checklist:
- Status page entry (olivia)
- Personalized emails to top-10 affected accounts (sam + olivia)
- Internal support template + FAQ (sam)
- Billing review flag for potential duplicate charges (finance)

olivia (cs): Status page draft (for review):
```
We experienced a partial degradation of generation services in US East on 2026-07-11 17:05 UTC.
Root cause under investigation.
Mitigation: Traffic routed to fallback model variant; runtime memory cap patch deployed.
We will provide a detailed RCA within 48 hours. Affected customers have been contacted directly.
```

leo (eng): Note — fallback model has ~30% higher per-token latency for some scenarios. Flagged to product to set expectations in comms.

renee (product): Approved. Also adding a line on next validation steps and offering credits per SLA if applicable — will coordinate with finance.

maya (oncall): Final status: error rates stable. I'll keep the page open for 2 hours for regression monitoring. Tom, please keep remediation PRs moving. I'll follow up on postmortem and customer-ready one-pager after the doc sprint.

incident-bot: Incident state changed: MITIGATED by maya, tom, leo at 1807504721. Close scheduled at 1807508521 if no regressions.

tom (sre): Thanks all. After the doc sprint I'll publish the final RCA and the customer one-pager. Please add any outstanding items to INC-2026-3381.

olivia (cs): I'll prepare the customer one-pager with supporting validation screenshots and test outputs — aim to share by EOD tomorrow.

sam (support): Holding on external billing notes until finance confirms duplicate-charge flags. Will send personalized follow-ups once one-pager approved. Closing thread when postmortem published.
